cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(sh3_qt_translations_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
enable_testing()
foreach(component "" Core CoreTools)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}/Qt6${component}Config.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT to an explicit Qt Base lib/cmake directory")
  endif()
  set(Qt6${component}_DIR "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}")
endforeach()
find_package(Qt6 6.11.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core
  PATHS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${SH3_QM_ROOT}" OR NOT EXISTS "${SH3_TS_ORACLE}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_QM_ROOT and SH3_TS_ORACLE to private catalog inputs")
endif()
add_executable(qtr_catalogs catalogs.cpp)
target_compile_features(qtr_catalogs PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(qtr_catalogs PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
target_compile_options(qtr_catalogs PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_link_libraries(qtr_catalogs PRIVATE Qt6::Core)
foreach(case catalogs spanish aggregate recovery missing-dependency)
  add_test(NAME qtr_${case} COMMAND qtr_catalogs "${case}" "${SH3_QM_ROOT}" "${SH3_TS_ORACLE}")
  set_tests_properties(qtr_${case} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
endforeach()
